verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online has an official V3 REST API with SDKs offering create/read/update/delete examples. Intuit's official MCP server claims 145 tools, full CRUD on 29 entity types, and 11 financial reports, so the core accounting objects are clearly reachable programmatically. However, nothing in the evidence shows API access to many UI features: bank reconciliation, the Intuit Intelligence chat, payroll, forecasting, custom roles and workflows, and backup/restore. The 'complete coverage' claim refers to the API itself, not to parity with the UI. Missing for 10: evidence of API parity for reconciliation, payroll, forecasting, roles/permissions and backup/restore; a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404); independent corroboration of coverage breadth.
